name: Cashew W180
description: W180 is one of the largest cashew grades. Every batch is sorted by hand to remove broken and discoloured pieces before it is packed.

name: Almonds
description: Whole almonds, sorted by hand for size and colour. Good for soaking overnight, snacking or baking.

name: Raisins
description: Seedless raisins, cleaned and sorted. Add them to kheer, halwa, salads or your breakfast bowl.

name: Walnut Kernels
description: Light-coloured walnut halves and pieces, checked for freshness before packing.

name: Pistachios
description: Pistachios in the shell, sorted to keep the ones that open easily.

name: Fox Nuts (Makhana)
description: Large-size makhana, graded and cleaned. Roast with a little ghee and salt for a quick snack.

name: Pumpkin Seeds
description: Raw, unsalted pumpkin seeds. Sprinkle on salads, smoothies and curd, or roast them lightly.

name: Sunflower Seeds
description: Raw, hulled sunflower seeds. A crunchy topping for salads, bowls and bakes.

name: Flax Seeds
description: Whole brown flax seeds, cleaned and sorted. Grind them fresh and add to rotis, smoothies or curd.

name: Chia Seeds
description: Clean black chia seeds. Soak them in water or milk for puddings and drinks.
